en.text: I have free time tomorrow, so I'm going hang out with my friends.
I'm free tomorrow so I'm going to hang out with my friends.

original: 今朝は、そんなことしてる暇はないと思うよ。

en.text: I don't think I have time to do that this morning.
I don't think that I have time to do that this morning.

original: 暇さえあれば、本を読んでます。

en.text: In my spare time, I enjoy reading.
Whenever I have free time, I read a book.
In my spare time, I read books.

original: 日曜日、暇？

en.text: Are you free on Sunday?

original: 全ての事務処理をやってる暇なんてないよ。

en.text: I never have time to get through all the paperwork.
I don't have time to do all the paperwork.

original: 暇だな。何しよっかな？

en.text: I'm bored. What shall I do?

original: お前のサンドイッチを作ってる暇なんてないよ。

en.text: I don't have time to make you a sandwich.

original: どうせ明日も明後日も暇なんだろう？

en.text: You're free tomorrow and the day after tomorrow anyway, right?

original: 暇だから寝よ。

en.text: I'm free now, so I'll just sleep.
I'm going to sleep because I have the time to.
Since we're free, let's go to bed.
Since I have some free time, I'll just go to sleep.

original: あなたのお遊びに付き合ってる暇なんてないの。

en.text: I don't have time for your games.

original: 2月27日はずっと暇よ。

en.text: On February 27th, I'll be free all day.
